# Graphic design · 平面

Posters, archives, decks, covers, packaging and the publications that track contemporary graphic design. The strongest moves available to a code-based designer are typographic, so typographic posters and historical archives are the richest sources.

40 resources, plus 4 cross-listed from other domains. Columns are explained in README.md; `scripts/catalog.py find` searches every domain at once. Rows are sorted by tier, then by reach, so what an agent can fetch comes first.

## Posters and typographic work · 海报与字体排印

Study grid, scale contrast and how little is on the page.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Design history archives · 设计史档案

Authentic period references instead of pastiche.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Letterform Archive Online](https://oa.letterformarchive.org) | High-resolution archive of lettering, type specimens and graphic design; free registration | Search by decade, technique or country for authentic period references | S | archive | static | free · login |  |
| [The Met Open Access and Collection API (home: assets)](https://metmuseum.github.io/) | Keyless JSON API over the Metropolitan Museum's collection; objects flagged isPublicDomain come with high-resolution CC0 images | Search /search?hasImages=true&q=<q>, fetch /objects/<id>, use primaryImage only when isPublicDomain is true; stay under 80 requests per second | A | api | static | free · CC0 for public-domain objects | API `https://collectionapi.metmuseum.org/public/collection/v1/search?hasImages=true&q={query}` |
| [People's Graphic Design Archive](https://peoplesgdarchive.org) | Crowd-sourced archive including everyday and under-documented graphic design | Find vernacular references outside the canon | A | archive | static | free |  |
| [Paul Rand](https://www.paulrand.design) | Comprehensive archive of Paul Rand's work and writing | Read /writing/articles/ (essays on logo presentation and design value) before presenting a mark | A | archive | static | free |  |
| [Design Reviewed](https://designreviewed.com) | Free graphic design history archive: 10,000+ scanned artefacts and 500+ designer profiles across 150 years | Browse /design-movement/<art-deco\|swiss-style…>/ and /magazines/ for authentic period references instead of pastiche | A | archive | static | free | [Archive](https://designreviewed.com/archive/) |

| [AIGA Design Archives](https://designarchives.aiga.org) | Decades of juried American graphic design | Search by format (book, poster, identity) | A | archive | blocked | free · archived |  |
| [Cooper Hewitt collection](https://www.si.edu/collections/cooper-hewitt) | Smithsonian design museum collection, now browsed through the Smithsonian collections site | Search by period, designer or object type | A | archive | blocked | free · Many images are CC0; check each object |  |

## Presentations and pitch decks · 演示与路演文稿

Narrative order first, slide system second.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Deck Gallery](https://deck.gallery) | Curated presentation decks: pitch decks, brand guidelines, reports, portfolios and talks, with per-slide pages | Use /category/pitch/, /category/guideline/ and /slides/ (slides by purpose) to compare title, statement, data and image slides; agents read the free JSON catalogue | A | gallery | static | free | [Pitch deck examples](https://www.deck.gallery/category/pitch/); [Public catalog API (OpenAPI)](https://www.deck.gallery/openapi.json); API `https://www.deck.gallery/api/catalog/decks.json` |
| [Best Pitch Deck](https://bestpitchdeck.com) | 1,400+ decks from funded start-ups with round, amount and year, filterable by stage, industry and business model | Filter with ?stage=Seed (or Series A…) and industry pages such as /AI; learn the narrative order before styling anything | A | gallery | static | free |  |
| [Sequoia: Writing a Business Plan](https://www.sequoiacap.com/article/writing-a-business-plan/) | The canonical pitch narrative outline | Use as the default story spine for an investor deck | A | article | static | free · archived |  |
| [Canva (home: social-og)](https://www.canva.com) | The default tool non-designers use for social graphics, decks and print, with brand kits, size presets and AI | When the client's team will produce assets themselves, deliver the system as a Canva brand kit and templates, not only as files | A | tool | blocked | freemium · login |  |
| [Pitch Deck Hunt](https://www.pitchdeckhunt.com) | Collection of notable pitch decks | Filter /stage/<pre-seed\|seed\|series-a> and /pitch-deck-examples/<industry>; second source after Best Pitch Deck | B | gallery | static | free |  |
| [Pitch templates](https://pitch.com/templates) | Professionally designed presentation templates | Reference for slide-layout systems | B | gallery | js | freemium · login |  |

## Covers and packaging · 封面与包装

Single-idea composition under a fixed frame.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Dieline](https://thedieline.com) | Leading packaging-design publication | Browse /category/redesigns/ and search by product category for shelf conventions before breaking them | A | article | static | free |  |
| [magCulture](https://magculture.com) | Jeremy Leslie's journal, podcast and shop on independent magazines; the best running record of editorial covers and spreads | Read /blogs/journal for issue-by-issue looks at covers and spreads | A | article | static | free | [Journal](https://magculture.com/blogs/journal) |
| [Pentawards](https://pentawards.com) | The global packaging design competition; winners by category and an annual trends report | Browse the winners by category before a packaging brief to learn shelf conventions, then decide which to break | A | archive | static | free | [Winners](https://pentawards.com/live/en/page/winners) |
| [The Casual Optimist](https://www.casualoptimist.com) | Dan Wagstaff's long-running blog on book covers, with monthly 'covers of note' round-ups and an annual best-of | Read the monthly round-ups for current cover typography and illustration | A | article | static | free |  |
| [Coverjunkie](https://coverjunkie.com) | Magazine covers chosen for their ideas | Reference for single-image, single-headline composition | A | gallery | js | free · slow |  |
